answer_1.quote: Understanding the discourse structure is advantageous for various downstream tasks, including dialogue generation, meeting summarization, sentiment analysis, and reading comprehension.

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we adopted micro-averaged F1 for both link prediction (LF1) and link&relation prediction (LRF1).

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 500 validation samples for the manual evaluation of ChatGPT, DCM, and DCM-CPO. One PhD candidate and two graduate students, experience in annotating discourse relations under the Segmented Discourse Representation Theory (SDRT), independently assessed whether the clarified or original utterances more clearly conveyed the intended relation types with their dependent utterances.
answer_4.guideline: assessed whether the clarified or original utterances more clearly conveyed the intended relation types with their dependent utterances
